Rice.description: Paddy is Kerala's staple crop, grown in wetlands. Ideal for lowlands like Kuttanad.
Rice.fertilizer: NPK 100:50:50 kg/ha; use urea, superphosphate. Organic: Compost 5 tons/ha.
Rice.pests_diseases: Stem borer, blast disease. Use neem oil; rotate crops.
Rice.optimization: For small farms (<2 acres), use SRI method to save 30% water. Drip irrigation for dry spells.

Coconut.description: Kerala's 'tree of life'; major plantation crop.
Coconut.pests_diseases: Rhinoceros beetle, bud rot. Use pheromone traps.
Coconut.optimization: For large farms (>10 acres), inter-crop with banana. Mulch to retain soil moisture.

Pepper.description: Kerala's spice king; vine crop on standards like silver oak.
Pepper.pests_diseases: Quick wilt, scale insects. Use Trichoderma for soil health.
Pepper.optimization: For medium farms (5-20 acres), shade planting reduces evaporation by 20%. Organic certification boosts price.

Banana.description: Quick-yielding fruit crop; popular in homesteads.
Banana.fertilizer: NPK 200:60:300 kg/ha; banana trash as mulch.
Banana.pests_diseases: Panama wilt, aphids. Use bio-agents like Pseudomonas.
Banana.optimization: For small farms, tissue culture plants for uniformity. Windbreaks to prevent lodging.

Rubber.pests_diseases: White root rot. Cover crops like calapagonia.
Rubber.optimization: For large farms, tapping schedules to optimize yield. Inter-crop with cocoa in early years.

general_tips.small_farm: Focus on high-value, low-input crops. Use vermicompost to cut fertilizer costs by 50%.
general_tips.medium_farm: Adopt mechanization like power tillers. Join FPOs for bulk inputs.
general_tips.large_farm: Implement precision farming (soil testing). Crop insurance via PMFBY.
general_tips.soil_improvement: Add gypsum for sodic soils; green manuring for nutrients.
general_tips.budget_low: Prioritize organics; government subsidies via KAU.
general_tips.beginner: Start with demo plots; attend Krishi Vigyan Kendra trainings.
